posts.name: Ishan Shishodiya
posts.cooked:
Your code doesn’t seem to work the way you showed. Anyways, the issue it that you’re looking for the wrong lines.

What you’re looking for -

Jan 21 21:46:27 IITMBSC su: pam_unix(su:session): session opened for user guest by student(uid=1002)

What to actually match -

Jan 21 21:46:49 IITMBSC su: (to student) student on pts/4

Now try extracting the part inside the brackets in these lines.
